Emily J. Carter  
Senior Data Scientist | HealthInsight Analytics | Tel Aviv, Israel  
Email: emily.carter@healthinsight.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/emilycarter | GitHub: github.com/emilycarter  

**Professional Summary**  
Results-driven data scientist with a decade of experience in healthtech, specializing in predictive analytics, scalable data pipelines, and cross-functional collaboration. Proven expertise in building production-grade systems that integrate machine learning, statistical modeling, and real-time data processing to drive clinical and operational insights.  

**HealthInsight Analytics**  
Senior Data Scientist | 2023–Present  
- Spearheaded MLOps architecture using MLflow and Weights & Biases, enabling seamless model deployment and tracking across 12+ projects. Mentored 3 junior data scientists in CI/CD practices and model versioning.  
- Designed Apache Airflow workflows to orchestrate ETL processes for 50+ million patient records, reducing data latency by 40% and improving dashboard responsiveness.  
- Leveraged Apache Spark for large-scale analysis of EHR data, optimizing query performance by 30% and enabling real-time risk stratification for 15,000+ patients.  
- Developed PyTorch-based deep learning models to predict hospital readmissions, achieving 89% accuracy and reducing avoidable admissions by 12%.  
- Engineered time series models for chronic disease progression, improving forecast accuracy by 18% and informing personalized care plans.  

**HealthPredict Analytics**  
Data Scientist | 2017–2023  
- Built REST APIs to integrate internal systems with third-party health data providers, streamlining data access for 10+ client reports.  
- Implemented Spark-based batch processing for clinical trial data, reducing processing time by 25% and enabling faster regulatory submissions.  
- Applied Bayesian statistics to predictive models for treatment response, increasing diagnostic accuracy by 10% and supporting 5 product improvements.  
- Conducted time series analysis on patient readmission rates, contributing to a 15% reduction in hospitalizations through early intervention strategies.  
- Designed data warehousing solutions for real-time analytics, supporting 50+ dashboards and improving cross-departmental data accessibility.  

**MedTech Solutions**  
Data Analyst | 2014–2017  
- Developed REST APIs for internal data reporting tools, reducing manual data aggregation efforts by 50%.  
- Utilized Python for data cleaning and analysis, delivering 10+ client reports that informed product development and clinical workflows.  
- Conducted statistical analysis on clinical trial data, identifying trends that supported 5 product improvements and 3 regulatory submissions.  
- Collaborated on data warehousing initiatives, reducing storage costs by 20% and improving query efficiency for 20+ stakeholders.
